author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಪುಟಿದು ಚಿಮ್ಮುವೆ ನೀನು ನೋವುಸೋಲುಗಳಿಂದ
ಸೆಟೆದು ನಿಲ್ಲೆಲೊ ಬದುಕೆ ಎಲ್ಲವೆದುರಿಸುತ
ಚಟುವಟಿಕೆ ಶುದ್ಧವಿರೆ ಸೋಲೆಗೆಲುವಾಗುವುದು
ಹಠಬಿಡದೆ ಮುನ್ನುಗ್ಗು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: You bounce back and spring up from pain and defeat;
stand tall, O life, facing everything;
when your actions are pure, defeat itself turns into victory:
press on without giving up, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Life keeps springing back from pain and failure, so stand firm and face whatever comes. If what we do is honest and pure, even a defeat becomes a kind of victory. Keep going, and don't give up.
